name: gamez_zbd_read_node_ref_list_indices
description: GameZ_ZBD::ReadNodeRefListIndices reads serialized node indexes into a node-reference list and converts them to live node pointers.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass ZBD/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x454bf0 validates zero-count success, fread of entryCount 32-bit indexes, failure line 0x2d0 through zError::ReportOldNoOp, and in-place conversion through GameZ_ZBD::NodeIndexToPtr.
The native node-ref-list smoke verifies readback of indexes 2, -1, and 0 into the matching node pointers and null sentinel, plus zero-count success.
